name: ns_proofsearch_cycle_resupply_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Successor after Phase 5EC: local signed Leray response is real but damping leaves only a 2/3 bound, so Clay-adjacent progress requires an independent cycle/resupply amplifier or same-ledger/no-resupply no-go.
description: Theorem-search substrate for the Navier-Stokes cycle/resupply bridge exposed by the signed Leray coordinate audits.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-search over a proof bridge, not numerical curve fitting.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by anti-tautology, damping, same-ledger, resupply, and cycle-transfer gates.
persona: You are a ruthless Navier-Stokes theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The finite-stencil and signed-coordinate searches have compressed the live problem to a cycle/resupply bridge: a 2/3 damped local response can only promote through an independent multiplier above 3/2, memory factor above 1/3, equivalent resupply theorem, or a no-go proving same-ledger/no-resupply. Reward ambitious proof packets and sharp no-go packets only when test_model.py exposes a top-level ledger_terms() or theorem function; prose-only ledgers do not count. Penalize observed-budget tautologies, phase-fitting, positive-energy laundering, ignoring Duhamel damping, finite-to-infinite supremum induction, weak-solution overclaims, and unbounded computation.

dimensions.name: Independent Cycle Object
dimensions.description: Are the signed coordinate, packet class, return rule, and cycle variables defined independently of observed gain/loss?

dimensions.name: Threshold Algebra
dimensions.description: Does the thesis correctly use the 2/3, 3/2, and 1/3 thresholds without laundering them into a theorem?

dimensions.name: Resupply Or Same-Ledger Split
dimensions.description: Does it either construct an independent resupply/amplifier route or prove a same-ledger/no-resupply obstruction?

dimensions.name: Duhamel And Viscous Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it pay source/output damping and recognize finite dwell is stricter than the infinite-time bound?

dimensions.name: Residual-Defect Ledger
dimensions.description: Does it report signed response together with residual, defect, and high-high or multi-background tax?

dimensions.name: Orientation And Pressure Admissibility
dimensions.description: Does it avoid phase/orientation hindsight and justify or tax pressure-aware Leray access?

dimensions.name: PSD And Positive-Energy Honesty
dimensions.description: Does it distinguish signed coordinate from positive energy and pay ballast if claiming positivity?

dimensions.name: Cycle Or Critical-Norm Transfer
dimensions.description: Does it connect to full danger-reset-return cycles, return-time geometry, critical norms, or smooth-data realization?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, no-go packet, exact falsifier, or decisive proof-cost reranking?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Resource Safety
dimensions.description: Does it avoid Clay overclaim and keep proposed audits bounded, sparse, symbolic, or proof-facing?

criteria.Independent_Cycle_Object: Full credit requires predeclared cycle variables, return rules, signed coordinate, and packet class. Score zero for defining amplifiers from observed G/L or target margin.
criteria.Threshold_Algebra: Full credit requires correct use of S=2/3, multiplier threshold 3/2, and memory threshold 1/3, including finite-time Duhamel worsening.
criteria.Resupply_Or_Same_Ledger_Split: Full credit requires either an independent amplifier/resupply theorem or a no-go forcing same-ledger/no-resupply behavior.
criteria.Duhamel_And_Viscous_Discipline: Full credit requires source/output Duhamel damping, viscous lifetime, or a rigorous reason the Phase 5EB/5EC tax is inapplicable.
criteria.Residual_Defect_Ledger: Full credit requires signed response, residual/defect, and high-high/multi-background tax to be reported together in a top-level test_model.py ledger_terms() or theorem function, not only in prose.
criteria.Orientation_And_Pressure_Admissibility: Full credit requires non-circular orientation and pressure-aware Leray admissibility or tax.
criteria.PSD_And_Positive_Energy_Honesty: Full credit requires explicit signed-coordinate nonclaim or diagonal ballast payment for any positive-energy claim.
criteria.Cycle_Or_Critical_Norm_Transfer: Full credit requires a bridge to danger-reset-return cycles, return-time geometry, critical norm, or smooth-data realization.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a usable theorem/falsifier/no-go packet or decisive route reranking.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Resource_Safety: Reject unsupported regularity/blowup claims and unbounded dense computation proposals.

success_criteria: A positive cycle/resupply bridge proving an independent multiplier > 3/2, memory > 1/3, or equivalent resupply inequality.
A no-go theorem proving same-ledger weighting/no-resupply for the admissible return class, exposed in test_model.py through top-level ledger_terms() or a named theorem function.
A bounded exact Fourier/CAS falsifier that kills a concrete amplifier mechanism and names the next theorem target.
failure_modes: Defining amplifier, memory, resupply, w, v, P, or L from observed gain/loss.
Choosing phases, amplitudes, signs, or return subsequences by solving backward from positive margin.
Ignoring Duhamel damping or viscous lifetime.
Ignoring residual/defect or high-high/multi-background stress, or stating them only in markdown while test_model.py lacks a top-level ledger.
Calling an indefinite signed coordinate positive energy without ballast.
Treating P_r M P_s as admissible merely because it commutes with Leray.
Inferring infinite-dimensional control from finite strict inequalities whose supremum can be one.
Claiming Clay regularity or blowup from this middle-layer object.
Using large dense Fourier jobs, unbounded Lean builds, or the crashed exponential metric transport obstruction.
